summaryDetail: The team is focused on executing SEO strategy for Asia Star and Intelligent China, with action items on target audience profiles and Google Ads tracking. The knowledge website redesign is underway, with feedback due on Joseph's design and a decision to disperse videos by topic. The China Going-Global report is nearing finalization, with cover selection made and final version pending. Upcoming events include the Tech in Asia Conference on Sept 15, where Dean Xiang will speak, and the monthly newsletter to be sent mid-month.
